status: Initial judgement estimates for the target scenario; not measured performance. Engineer days include briefing, implementation intervention, integration and acceptance; principal days cover engineering assurance and decisions. Agent durations are occupied execution slots, not human effort.
principal_effort_definition: Rows are raw allowances; scenario model applies the explicit 1.5 human-review policy multiplier. This is human every-merge approval and engineering decisions, separate from agent cross-review. Stretch must not reduce human review below that policy allowance.
physical_work_definition: Physical active and operator effort are held constant across primary scenarios. Operator effort is additional to Engineer/Principal work and has no recovered baseline for a claimed saving. Extended offline/replay observation is covered in the system-soak procedure; short per-feature fault/recovery runs remain active target checks.

estimate_rationale.platform_and_interfaces: Reuse existing MicroPython platform, bootloader and project conventions assumed by the source. Workers implement bounded contracts; engineer time covers decisions and corrections rather than manual authorship of every change.
estimate_rationale.control_and_lifecycle: Larger human and target allowances for control tuning, sensor behaviour, safe state and recovery; mocked logic evidence does not replace target acceptance.
estimate_rationale.verification: Independent agent review consumes its own execution slot. Principal review and engineer acceptance remain explicit. Physical observation allowances are added separately and not accelerated by scenario execution multipliers.
estimate_rationale.limitations: No measured token-to-output throughput, defect distribution or project-specific calibration is available. These are an aggressive, inspectable hypothesis to revise using the first execution wave. Review effort is not inferred from source speed-up labels.
